svg.title: cite
svg.desc: Animated diagram: the word cite above a deploy. Blue is live, green starts, both are live while traffic shifts, then blue drains and goes down, and the roles swap back. A firewall blocks a request for .env.
svg.text: one connector per node, one dashboard for all of them
green starts and passes its health check
both live: traffic shifts to green
green serves all traffic, blue is down
blue starts and passes its health check
both live: traffic shifts to blue
